item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Sharif’s 2024 record does not show a clear net improvement in domestic safety. There are a few real restraint/protection signals, especially counterterrorism coordination and some dialogue-first crisis handling, but the stronger record is negative: election shutdowns, protest crackdowns, targeted arrests, internet blocks, and continued abuse of minorities. Overall: citizens were not clearly left safer than they were inherited. Confidence: moderate.

**Supporting Evidence**
- [PM for collective efforts to eliminate menace of terrorism](https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-06-22  
  Claim-level summary: Sharif launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and promised resources for the armed forces. This is the strongest pro-safety item, because it addresses a real violent threat through formal state coordination.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.7`, `3B.6`

- [PM Shehbaz urges AJK govt, political leadership to resolve issues through dialogue](https://www.radio.gov.pk/12-05-2024/pm-shehbaz-urges-ajk-govt-political-leadership-to-resolve-issues-through-dialogue) | Radio Pakistan | 2024-05-12  
  Claim-level summary: Sharif told Azad Kashmir leaders to negotiate with the action committee and resolve the dispute peacefully. This is a genuine restraint signal, though narrow and local.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `2B.7`, `3B.6`

- [PM condemns Besham attack, says perpetrators will be brought to justice](https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/24838) | Press Information Department, Pakistan | 2024-03-27  
  Claim-level summary: After the Besham attack, Sharif condemned the killing of civilians and promised swift justice. This is a restrained response to a sudden crisis, but it is reactive rather than proof of a broader safety gain.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.7`, `3B.4`

- [Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on peoples' rights](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/) | Amnesty International | 2024-02-08  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty condemned the telecom and mobile internet shutdown during the election period. This is coercive administrative control and a warning sign that the state was not reducing domestic insecurity in a rights-protective way.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.8`, `3B.5`, `3B.2`

- [Pakistan Government Intensifies Crackdown on Political Dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-09  
  Claim-level summary: HRW reported over 500 arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, and mobile internet cuts during PTI protests, including arrests of peaceful protesters. This is strong evidence of domestic insecurity being managed through repression, not protection.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.8`, `3B.5`, `3B.2`

- [Urgent and transparent investigation needed into deadly crackdown on opposition protesters](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/urgent-and-transparent-investigation-needed-into-deadly-crackdown-on-opposition-protesters/) | Amnesty International | 2024-11-27  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty said the Islamabad crackdown involved deaths, mass detentions, and a broader intolerance of peaceful assembly. This is the clearest evidence against a net safety improvement in domestic violence and political insecurity.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.8`, `3B.1`, `3B.2`

- [End escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/) | Amnesty International | 2024-06-21  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and blocking of Ahmadi rites, with authorities failing to ensure safety. This is strong evidence that intergroup insecurity remained unresolved and that vulnerable groups were not made safer.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.7`, `3B.6`, `3B.2`

- [Pakistan: The new Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act threatens the right to protest](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/pakistan-the-new-peaceful-assembly-and-public-order-act-threatens-the-right-to-protest/) | Amnesty International | 2024-09-09  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty said the law was rushed through and would criminalize peaceful assembly rather than protect it. That cuts against a safer domestic environment because it expanded control over dissent instead of reducing fear.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.9`, `3B.8`, `3B.5`

- [Pakistan authorities must end escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/) | Amnesty International | 2024-06-21  
  Claim-level summary: Amnesty says district authorities issued preventive detentions and that police and provincial governments acted extrajudicially across the country. This is direct evidence that domestic insecurity and communal violence were not being reliably suppressed without abuse.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.7`, `3B.2`, `3B.5`

- [Pakistan: Widening Crackdown on Dissent](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11  
  Claim-level summary: HRW said the government clamped down on dissenting media, the opposition, and NGOs, and that deportations of undocumented Afghans occurred without safeguards against police abuse. This shows vulnerable people were not clearly safer in 2024 than before.  
  Question IDs: `3B.10`, also `3B.7`, `3B.8`, `3B.5`, `3B.2`

**Search Gap**
I did not find credible evidence that Sharif’s 2024 government produced a broad, measurable reduction in political violence, intergroup violence, or preventable domestic insecurity. The positive items are limited to specific crises and counterterrorism actions, while the best-documented trend is continued or intensified coercion.
